architectural_findings: the naive bilinear q(S_above,S_below) representation is rejected because it does not preserve the hydrostatic zero-flow manifold between nodes
factoring the exact driving head g=L+h_above-h_below preserves flux sign and hydrostatic zero-flow structurally
log10(-h) coordinates and interpolation of log(q/g) provide the first qualified bounded representation for the B01 fixture
runtime lookup remains O(1), the table is immutable shared material-geometry data, and persistent per-column table state is zero
scope_limit: This qualifies one homogeneous unsaturated B01 face of length 10 cm over h in [-10000,-1] cm with KSATEXM disabled. It does not qualify catalog-wide hydraulics, saturation transitions, heterogeneous profiles, transient timestep accuracy, bottom boundaries, groundwater, process physics, MultiSWAP, response tangents for the real table, or FullRichards equivalence.
